Under RCW 81.28.050, a change for solid waste collection companies may not be made except after 
45-days' notice to both the commission and to the public.
We are requesting to follow WAC 480-70-271 (2)(a) which would allow for notification on the customer's 
first invoice after approval.
To implement an updated commodity rebate for the upcoming year.
WM would like to use WAC 480-70-271(2)(a)(ii) so that each affected customer will receive notice on or with the first bill after 
the effective date of July 1, 2026 as this would reduce supplies and mailing expense.
